governingIdea: State becoming structure: motion makes uncertainty, understanding, judgment, decision, consequence, and memory legible without simulating hidden thought.
coreRule: AI Council motion explains observable system state. It may not invent work, progress, reasoning, specialist activity, or completion that the runtime cannot prove.

counterpoint.rule: Motion supports reading rhythm and human judgment without magazine pacing or decorative flourish.

decisionSpine.rule: Lines, directional travel, and staged settlement appear only where a real relationship, chronology, or provenance chain exists.

threshold.rule: Threshold motion appears only when authority or consequence changes. It never becomes permanent navigation or ordinary conversation motion.

loading.definition: A technical resource or view is not yet ready.
loading.visualRule: Use a bounded loading treatment that does not claim semantic work is occurring.
loading.claimRule: May say Loading only when a real resource request is pending.

working.definition: Council is performing a known runtime operation.
working.visualRule: Current known stage may move gently; completed stages settle. No percentage unless the runtime exposes a deterministic total.
working.claimRule: Every named work stage requires a matching active runtime event.

reasoning-status.definition: A high-level inspectable reasoning lifecycle state such as task understanding, evidence planning, strategy comparison, or verification.
reasoning-status.visualRule: Expose structured status only, never hidden chain-of-thought or imagined internal dialogue.
reasoning-status.claimRule: Status text must map to an explicit lifecycle event or artifact state.

execution-progress.definition: Council is modifying real external or repository state after authority has been granted.
execution-progress.visualRule: Show actual operation steps and verification states; failure stops motion rather than escalating visual noise.
execution-progress.claimRule: Each started/completed/failed step requires an execution or validation event with an operation identifier.

speedHierarchy.rule: Consequence may be more deliberate than ordinary navigation; slowness is never used as a premium effect by itself.

primitives.behavior: Submitted message settles 4–6px into the thread and becomes stable before any work status appears.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate placement plus short opacity settle.

primitives.behavior: A quiet status line appears only while task-understanding is active; one directional tick may traverse once, then the state settles.
primitives.reducedMotion: Opacity-only status change.

primitives.behavior: Real context items register quietly in the inspector; current context state moves once, completed context settles without repeated checkmark animation.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate item registration with opacity change.

primitives.behavior: Evidence rows enter at their final location with a 4–6px registration movement; provenance becomes visible without flying cards or graph animation.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate row appearance plus border/opacity settle.

primitives.behavior: Specialist roles appear as factual coordination states—Reviewed, Reviewing, Waiting—without avatars, speech bubbles, or simulated dialogue.
primitives.reducedMotion: State labels update without translation.

primitives.behavior: Options remain visually neutral while evaluation is active. After comparison completes, viable/recommended/rejected states reveal once; no racing scores or animated rankings.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate state labels and hierarchy change.

primitives.behavior: Working copy evolves only when the active runtime stage changes. The current stage uses one restrained directional indicator; completed stages settle; unknown future stages are omitted.
primitives.reducedMotion: Text/state changes only.

primitives.behavior: Recommendation, rationale, risks, and next action reveal by completed section with small opacity/vertical transitions; text is not animated character-by-character by default.
primitives.reducedMotion: Sections appear immediately as ready.

primitives.behavior: Normal verification settles quietly. A real issue interrupts flow with a deliberate still state and explicit problem copy.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate status switch with emphasis change.

primitives.behavior: A meaningful conflict interrupts the normal reveal rhythm; surrounding motion stops and the issue becomes the current reading anchor.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate issue anchor and halted activity.

primitives.behavior: The quiet advisory surface yields to a single consequence boundary; consequence color appears, controls become explicit, and the interface pauses before authorization is available.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate boundary/state change; preserve consequence structure and wording.

primitives.behavior: Actual operation steps advance from approved to executing to completed using event-driven state changes. No indefinite decorative spinner when a step state is known.
primitives.reducedMotion: State labels update without directional travel.

primitives.behavior: Validation appears as a real execution stage after modification; passed state settles rather than celebrating.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate validation state update.

primitives.behavior: Completed work resolves into stable project history; checkmarks settle once and the resulting decision/outcome becomes durable. No confetti or celebratory burst.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate durable completed state.

primitives.behavior: Normal activity stops. The failed step becomes still, consequence copy explains what stopped and what did not happen, then recovery actions become available.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate stopped state and recovery controls.

primitives.behavior: Evidence → decision → action → outcome or previous → superseded → current lineage draws/reveals only where those relationships exist.
primitives.reducedMotion: Show complete lineage immediately with subtle opacity emphasis on current node.

primitives.behavior: Superseded memory recedes into historical status while the replacement becomes active; removal from active truth never visually implies historical erasure.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate lifecycle/status update with both records visible.

primitives.behavior: Context/evidence panels use short opacity and 6–10px directional movement; the center conversation never shifts theatrically.
primitives.reducedMotion: Immediate panel visibility plus opacity transition.

primitives.behavior: Project/thread navigation opens as one focused sheet with restrained vertical movement. No stacked sliding panels or simultaneous transitions.
primitives.reducedMotion: Sheet appears without translation.

primitives.behavior: Remove nonessential translation, drawing, parallax, looping indicators, and staged delay. Preserve status wording, hierarchy, consequence boundaries, progress truth, focus, and final states.
primitives.reducedMotion: This primitive is the reduced-motion contract.

antiPatterns: generic pulsing dots for every state
animated scores while strategy evaluation is still running
motion that suggests a step completed before a completed event exists
